subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the given word.**

Lure
solution: The correct answer is '**Attract**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Lure**' is '**Attract**'. • **Lure**: the attractive qualities of something. (प्रलोभन, आकर्षण) • *Example: the **lure** of money/fame/adventure...* • **Attract**: to cause somebody/something to go to something or give attention to something. (आकर्षित करना; आकृष्‍ट करना; लुभाना) • *Example: Moths are **attracted** to light.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.** **Correct Answer:__***** ****Attract.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Attack**: trying to hurt or defeat somebody/something by using force. (आक्रमण, हमला) • **Amend**: to change something slightly in order to make it better. (बेहतर बनाने के लिए ज़रा-सा सुधारना; संशोधित करना) • **Arise**: to begin to exist; to appear. (अस्तित्व में आना; प्रकट होना) 36:T694, The erroneous part is** 'have been notify'.**
